messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

This includes postoperative pain.
Postoperative pain is pain after surgery.

It may be used as an alternative to other forms of pain relief.
Those other forms did not relieve pain well enough or were not tolerated.
Tramadol extended-release capsules may be used by adults.
The adults require around-the-clock treatment of their moderate to moderately severe chronic pain.
The treatment is for an extended time.
Tramadol should not be used in children younger than 12 years old.
It should not be used in anyone younger than 18 years old with other risk factors, such as breathing problems.
It should not be used in anyone who has recently had surgery to remove their tonsils or adenoids.
Extended-release tramadol (Ultram ER) should not be given to anyone younger than 18 years.

The relation 'is for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject treatment or action is intended for the duration or purpose specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires': The subject condition requires the action or intervention specified by the object entity.
B. 'must be applied by': The subject device or treatment requires application or use by the entity specified by the object.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
